# Vendored: AnySWF platform layer

Copied unmodified from the AnySWF repository (`repos/anyswf/platform/`, MIT,
same author), commit `4015da94d20fda68afac0c2ef6ca7766ef9e23e2`. It is the
workspace's shared PSP platform layer (GU frame setup, input, audio thread,
files, clock) with a `psp/` and an `sdl/` backend.

Do not edit these files here. Change the layer in AnySWF and copy it again,
recording the new commit above.
